text: Ilith, of the Vapouriun. I carry the Guild's messages - the rivers are faster than the roads, if you know them.
There's an old stone on the west shore of the lake along the Hollow Road. Older than the Guild. Would you read it for me?
We were born of the rivers, the stories say. Quick, curious, and we fight with small blades and smaller mistakes.
The scales? They shift colour with the tide. You're staring.
Thank you. The lake's west shore, on the Hollow Road. Look for the carved stone.
The stone is on the lake's west shore along the Hollow Road. Face it and press A.
'The water remembers every face it has shown.' ...So it's true. Thank you.
Take this - and a few marks for your trouble.
The lake is calm today. That's a good sign, for us.
